Initial release of mcp-server-builder.

- Wrapper for building MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers around your data/APIs as agent tools.
- FastAPI integration with fastmcp template for quick conversion to MCP-tools.
- Includes template script, test flow, and publishing instructions.
- Supports API-key authentication via environment variables.
- Guides for publicizing your MCP-server on various platforms.
